title: mcp-audits belongs on your radar
description:
korrel-dev/mcp-audits is the kind of repo that can quietly upgrade a developer workflow. Weekly security audits of remote MCP servers. OAuth 2.1, PKCE, DCR, token hygiene, and the spec gaps nobody's reading. It has about 2 GitHub stars, and it is active enough to deserve a closer look. Save this for your next build, and follow for more useful developer tools.

https://github.com/korrel-dev/mcp-audits
